purpose: Front-door NonImpactProof registry. When an iteration assesses that a change has NO impact on the human front door, an explicit proof with a corroborating evidence_pr exempts that surface from the staleness assertions enforced by tools/validate_human_front_door.py. Silent omission is not permitted: only explicitly filed proofs exempt a surface. An empty exemptions array means every front-door surface is still in scope and must be verified current.
